items.note: Builds; reading real receipts not yet run against a server.

items.item: openChanges and setThread on the IDE bridge
items.note: Builds; not yet run against a server.

items.item: Delegation panel in the dock with the full receipt, check output and the child run's events
items.note: Built against a fixture; child run events not yet run against a server.

items.item: @theia/ai-chat and @theia/ai-chat-ui in the browser-only build without Theia's own agents or providers
items.note: Theia boots with the AI chat; ai-core-ui and ai-mcp come in as dependencies of ai-chat-ui, and no Theia agent or language model is registered.

items.item: Theorem chat agent on the thread from setThread: text, reasoning, tool calls, approvals
items.note: The UI host stays the only sender: Theia mirrors the thread through setThread diffs and its agent sends through host.send. The agent is the default and answers in the standalone frame; a linked turn is not yet run against a server.

items.item: Delegations as Theia change sets with diff opening over theorem-delegation
items.note: One change set per turn, one element per changed file, admission mapped to element state; no apply or revert. Not yet run against a server.

items.item: Follow the Agent follows run-attributed document events
items.note: Built: the UI hands the frame the working turn's run and its delegations' runs, and the frame reveals document.changed edits whose actor is theorem:run:<id>. Tool-call path parsing is gone. Waits on 1.4 to emit attributed revisions.

items.item: Fork into new thread and Continue in new thread
items.note: Built: Fork into new thread on an assistant reply's More menu, and Fork into new thread and Continue in new thread on each thread's context and More menus, through threads.create with origin; a failure shows in the sidebar. Not yet run against a server that stores origins.

items.item: Sidebar nests origin children beside branches
items.note: Built: threads nest under their listed source beside its branches, recursively, with a fork or continuation mark; a tree sorts by its latest thread. Checked in the browser on fixture data; not yet against a server.
